split_rule: V2: validation only (v2main/val). V2 test untouched. Test predictions are used ONLY in D, for calibration reporting with a val-fitted scale (no selection).

A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.claim_tested: zero-shot cross-dataset is unreliable, but prior + few in-target simulations recovers it
A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.gt: physical.json E (Pa), elastic; rho = 1000 assumed (as v3f), so log10(E/rho*1000) = log10 E
A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.geometry: released simulation/<scene>/000.ply particles (frame 0), random subsample (seed 0) to <= 150000
A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.initial_state: physical.json INIT_VELOCITY, gravity -9.8 y, ground plane y = BC.GROUND, slip friction 0.3
A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.engine: our mpm_solver_warp jelly (fixed corotated), rho 1000, rpic 0, grid_v_damping 0.99999, grid_lim 1.2 / n_grid 120, CFL dt (0.25 dx / c)
A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.observation: canonical v3f triplet t0 (3 views), 30 frames, RGBA on black, 512 -> 128 px, mask alpha > 0.5
A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.render: particle colours from the PLY, pinhole projection with released K/c2w, z-buffered disk splats, radius r in {0,1,2} px chosen per scene by frame-0 IoU of GT particles (geometry only, no dynamics)
A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.objective: (1 - mean mask IoU) + RGB-MAE(union)/255 over 3 views x 30 frames (C1 objective; RGB from un-shaded particle colours)
A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.optimizer: C1 compass search, 1-D log10 E, step 0.5 halved on failure, min 0.02, bounds [1.5, 6.5]; nu fixed per arm; failed sims loss 9

arms.prior: 9-run ensemble K0 zero-shot (canonical triplet) log10 E and nu from docs/v3f/SPRINGGAUS_SYN.json ensemble9.K0.z_t0
arms.jellymean: uninformed: V2 train-split mean of the jelly law (z-space mean of ln1p(E/rho)), nu = jelly train mean

diagnostics_not_estimators.renderer_upper_bound: released GT particle trajectory of every frame rendered with the same splatter vs observed frames
diagnostics_not_estimators.gt_replay: our engine with GT E and GT nu (engine-mismatch floor)
diagnostics_not_estimators.landscape: loss at log10 E in {3.5,...,6.5} step 0.5 with prior nu

A_springgaus_in_target_refinement.metrics: Spearman and pairwise order accuracy (ties excluded, 83 pairs) of log10 E vs GT; mean |dlog10 E| and mean |dz| (V2 train-standardised ln1p E/rho) vs GT; paired scene bootstrap 95% CI (2000 draws, seed 17) for after - before and prior - jellymean at each budget.

B_reconstructed_geometry.geometry: 3-view visual hull from the frame-0 object masks of the observed sample_pack (cameras = the pipeline synthetic orbit cameras with random_render_views_seed = index), voxel carving in the normalised MPM frame, largest component, written as a 3DGS PLY (colours from frame-0 RGB of visible views) and fed through the identical asset routine (x90, robust quantile normalisation, particle filling). Code: scripts/v3k/b_hull.py (diagnostics in data/v3k/hull_assets/<idx>/hull_meta.json).
B_reconstructed_geometry.refinement: prior_top1 (9-run ensemble, top-1 law, no probes) with the C1 objective vs the ORIGINAL observed video, budget 12, report 0/4/12 (scripts/v3k/bc_refine.py --variant hull)
B_reconstructed_geometry.replay: unseen action ACTIONS[(i+3)%6] with hull geometry at budgets 0/4/12 vs a fresh GT replay (GT asset, GT parameters)
B_reconstructed_geometry.diagnostic: GT parameters + hull geometry on the observed action (geometry-only floor), run last
B_reconstructed_geometry.comparison: existing GT-asset prior_top1 states data/v3b_refine/v2main_C_seed29/<idx>/prior_top1/state.json on the same samples (z-MAE at 0/4/12, replay IoU 0/4/12)
B_reconstructed_geometry.metric: identifiable z-MAE (E/rho, sigma_y/rho; pooled elements), object-clustered bootstrap 95% CI of paired differences (2000, seed 17)

C_simulator_mismatch.observed: regenerated with GT parameters (incl. true hardening/softening), GT asset, same cameras/action, perturbed simulator
C_simulator_mismatch.refinement: prior_top1 with the nominal simulator, budget 12, report 0/4/12 (scripts/v3k/bc_refine.py --variant mismatch); no replay
C_simulator_mismatch.comparison: matched simulator = existing prior_top1 states on the same samples (original V2 observed video)

intervals: ens: across-run std of the 9 runs
total: sqrt(mean aleatoric var + across-run var)
D_calibration.temperature: single scalar per target fitted on val (closed form T^2 = mean r^2/sigma^2); test reported raw and with the val-fitted T only

queue: a800-2 shared queue, docs/v3k/queue.json (ids v3k_), GPUs 0-7, max_per_gpu 5

addendum_1_before_B_sims.hull_build: scripts/v3k/b_hull.py --vox 0.006 --dilate 1 (mpm units / px); only the surface shell is written as gaussians, the pipeline particle filling fills the interior; colours from visible frame-0 views, rest mean colour
addendum_1_before_B_sims.sample_212: released object mask is all ones in every frame (broken); hull uses background subtraction for 212; 212 is kept in the pre-registered set but B/C results are ALSO reported excluding 212 (both arms)
addendum_1_before_B_sims.camera_check: GT filled particles project inside the frame-0 masks for 0.97-1.00 (19/20), 0.83 for 118
